title: telegram-ads-mcp review-account artifact
description: Output of prompt review-account. A later job may persist this JSON. IDs and money are strings. At most 5 problem ads and exactly one recommendation. No cookies, hashes, DevTools, or full charts.

status.description: Active / Stopped / on_hold / active as on the list

spent.description: Gram (TON), already in list units — do not divide

why.description: one-line why this ad is a problem

recommendation.description: Exactly one suggested change (pause xor CPM xor budget xor text). Do not apply until the operator asks.

problems.why: Stopped with leftover daily_budget; increasing budget would resume delivery.

examples.recommendation: Pause ad 35 or leave Stopped; do not increase budget without confirm=true.
